item.title: Lesson 71: “Only God’s plan for salvation will work.”
item.description: “Only God’s plan for salvation will work.” You may not realize that the ego has set up a plan for salvation in opposition to God’s. It is this plan in which you believe. Since it is the opposite of God’s, you also believe that to accept God’s plan in place of the ego’s is to be damned. This sounds preposterous, of course.
